updates.tweet_text: Biggest difference I've noticed between green & red traders is red traders obsess about what price will do: "Is the top in?", "will we rally to X then sell to Y?" Nobody knows. Green traders react to what price is doing. Plan all scenarios & trade what you see, not what you think
